description: This Java class handles API exceptions for the inventory service, mapping specific exceptions to corresponding HTTP error responses.

classes.name: ApiExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller advice that intercepts exceptions thrown within the inventory API and returns appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NotFound exceptions, returning a 404 NOT FOUND response with an error message.

methods.name: handleInvalid
methods.description: Handles InvalidQuantity exceptions, returning a 400 BAD REQUEST with an error message.

methods.name: handleInsufficient
methods.description: Handles InsufficientAvailable exceptions, returning a 409 CONFLICT with an error message.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles generic exceptions, returning a 500 INTERNAL SERVER ERROR with a generic error message.
